reviews.text: This tone-up cream set is an absolute staple for achieving a naturally bright, glowy complexion. Its lightweight, non-sticky formula absorbs smoothly to instantly even out skin tone without leaving a harsh white cast. The extra 10ml mini makes it super convenient for touch-ups on the go!
reviews.zh: 呢套提亮霜係打造自然明亮、有光澤膚色嘅必備之選。佢質地輕盈、唔黏，塗抹時吸收順滑，即刻令膚色均勻，而且冇留下生硬嘅泛白感。附送嘅 10ml 迷你裝好方便，外出補妝超級方便！

reviews.shade: [SET] Tone-Up Cream 50ml (+Pingu Blusher 01 Honey Pink 1.7g, Pingu Sticker)
reviews.text:
I tried the light cream and noticed it felt a bit sticky after application—I’m not sure if that’s typical for this type of product. On the bright side, it definitely delivers a whitening effect. 

I was also excited to try the adorable little blusher, but unfortunately the pigmentation turned out too weak and it didn’t last long on my skin.
reviews.zh:
我試咗淺色嗰款霜，塗完之後覺得有少少黏——唔知呢類產品係咪都係咁。好嘅一面係，佢確實有提亮效果。

我亦好期待試吓嗰款可愛嘅小腮紅，不過發色太弱，而且喺皮膚上持久力唔夠。

reviews.text: It’s my third time ordering. Love that it comes with a free powder. Powder is fine and definitely covers up the pores. Cosnori leaves me looking fresh the whole day at work. I work at a hospital in the US as an RN suowrvsior and need to always look presentable to patients and their relatives. You should definitely try this.
reviews.zh: 呢個係我第三次訂購。好鍾意附送嘅粉餅。粉餅都幾好，而且絕對可以遮蓋毛孔。Cosnori 令我返工成日都睇落精神抖擻。我喺美國一間醫院做 RN suowrvsior，要時刻讓病人同佢哋家屬睇落得體。你一定要試吓呢款。

reviews.text:
I like using the cream with my daily moisturizer. It is very lightweight and absorbs into the skin nicely with even coverage. You can also layer it to get to the tone of your choice. The cream is long lasting for the most part, however I would recommend reapplying at least one more time when you can, as it may wear off as you wash your hands throughout the day. I would say it’s water resistant, but not water proof. It won’t melt off if you put your hand in water, but when you wash your hands thoroughly it does come off a bit. I do like how the cream looks on my face, though. I don’t have any complaints with the facial application.

I don’t see people talking about the powder pact, so I will. The powder pact is a setting powder with lightening properties. The mirror in the powder pact is really nice and the powder has a nice matte finish. Although I haven’t used it on my face yet, I put it on the back of my hand. I will use this powder and the cream until it both runs out :)
reviews.zh:
我鍾意將霜同日常保濕霜一齊用。質地好輕，吸收得好好，均勻覆蓋。亦可以疊加，調到自己想要嘅色調。大致上持久力都好，不過我建議有機會嘅話至少補擦多一次，因為洗手嗰陣會慢慢脫落。我覺得佢係抗水，但唔係防水。手浸入水度唔會即時脫，但如果用力洗手就會脫走少少。我都好鍾意霜塗喺面上嘅效果，用喺面上方面，我冇咩要投訴。

我見冇人講粉餅，所以我講吓。呢個粉餅係一款有提亮效果嘅定妝粉。粉餅入面嘅鏡子好好，粉嘅啞光效果都幾好。雖然我未喺面上試過，但我塗咗喺手背。我會用呢款粉餅同霜，直至兩樣都用完 :)

reviews.shade: Tone Up Special Set (Powder + Zzanggu Sticker)
reviews.text: Get the 9wishes one. This one doesn’t spread as easily and dries too quickly. Wouldn’t recommend for dry skin because of the texture, but still wouldn’t recommend to oily skin because it’s not easy to use. The tone up effect is great and not ashy but it’s nothing 9wishes can’t do while having spf.
reviews.zh: 買 9wishes 嗰款啦。呢款唔太易推開，而且乾得太快。因為質地關係，我唔會推介俾乾性肌，但我都唔會推介俾油性肌，因為唔太易用。提亮效果好好，唔會發灰，不過呢款冇嘢係 9wishes（有 SPF 嗰款）做唔到嘅。

reviews.text: I heard about this whitening cream for the longest time and had been debating whether to try it out or not, but now I did. At first when you apply, especially if you have a deeper skin tone, it’s going to make you look pale for a few hours, once it settles in, it should just tone up your skin a bit and making it look flawless. Overall good experience with it. It is definitely tear proof, I cried with it on and it still didn’t smudge or look like I had applied anything at all.
reviews.zh: 我聽咗呢款美白霜好耐，一直猶豫要唔要試，而家終於試咗。一開始塗嘅時候，特別係如果你膚色比較深，佢會令你幾個鐘都睇落好似好蒼白，等佢穩定咗之後，應該就會稍微提亮膚色，令皮膚睇落無瑕。整體嚟講體驗幾好。佢絕對防淚，我戴住佢哭，都冇暈開，好似完全冇塗過嘢咁。

reviews.text: Very nice tone up cream. I really like that it’s not drying and spreads very easily with no oily feeling. Drys down very fast and isn’t too white. I like using it on my neck as well to help even out the skin tone and ensure my face and neck are the same shade in some cases when my base makeup is a bit lighter
reviews.zh: 好好用嘅提亮霜。我好鍾意佢唔會乾燥，而且好易推開，冇油膩感。好快乾身，又唔會太白。我亦會塗喺頸上，幫助調勻膚色；如果我嘅底妝比較淺色，佢仲可以令面同頸嘅膚色一致。

reviews.text:
The cream is instant natural whitening. 
However, it is dry out the skin. Therefore, for the dry skin type, you need a very moisture base to use it without causing cracks or white cast. 
I use it on top of my cushion/tint sunscreen to brighten up the face and to set my makeup without finishing powder. 
It is not causing any allergic reaction to my sensitive face, and it contains Niacinamide, which treats/prevents acne.
reviews.zh:
呢款霜即時有自然美白效果。
不過，佢會令皮膚乾燥。因此，如果係乾性肌，需要先用非常滋潤嘅底妝，先至唔會乾裂或者泛白。
我會塗喺 cushion／防曬 tint 上面，用嚟提亮面部，唔使再用定妝粉。
對我敏感嘅面部冇引起敏感反應，而且含有煙酰胺（Niacinamide），有助治療或預防暗瘡。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
